about_short_description.short_description: Orcas is a hybrid tutoring platform with tailored learning plans for K-12 students in MENAP (Egypt, KSA, and Pakistan).

product.name: Orcas Tutoring
product.description: A platform offering one-on-one tutoring sessions for K-12 students across various subjects and school systems in MENAP, available online or in-person.

product.name: Orcas Learning Hub
product.description: A digital tool for tutors to log session details, track student progress, assign homework, and communicate with parents.

product.name: Orcas Online Classroom
product.description: An online tutoring environment powered by Zoom, enabling interactive one-on-one sessions with tools like whiteboards and high-quality audio/video.

product.name: AI Teaching Assistant (AI TA)
product.description: An AI-powered tool that helps tutors create customized lesson plans and homework tailored to individual student needs and learning styles.
